other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits global transformations (TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and frequency encoding) on the entire training set before executing the cross-validation split. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, likely resulting in overly optimistic validation metrics.

other_failure_modes.name: Ignoring test set IDs for submission
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates submission IDs using `np.arange` instead of preserving the actual identifier column from the test set. This will result in a mismatched and failing submission file if the test IDs are not strictly 0-indexed sequential integers.

summary: The agent provides a robust pipeline featuring datetime extraction, text processing with TF-IDF/SVD, cross-validation, and an ensemble of gradient boosting classifiers. However, its implementation suffers from cross-validation leakage (fitting transformers prior to splitting folds), ignores the temporal nature of the data by using a randomized split, and uses a naive hardcoded ensemble. Critically, it overrides the original test IDs in the submission file, which will likely cause the evaluation to fail.
